#system.util.getLogger("PFS2 Script 2").info("previousValue: {}".format(previousValue.value))
    #system.util.getLogger("PFS2 Script 2").info("currentValue: {}".format(currentValue.value))
    import system
    try:
        errorCode = currentValue.value #Sets error code
        prevErrorCode = previousValue.value # Sets previous error code
        if errorCode != prevErrorCode:
            db = "BACC_PFS2" #Establishes datbase as db
            
            #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("Script running")
            
            
            
            #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 1")        
            # ----- READING IN NEEDED TAGS ------
            
            tags = system.tag.readBlocking([
                "[default]BACC_PFS2/Faults/Day_Stop_Count", # Number of times machine has stopped since 7am
                "[default]BACC_PFS2/Faults/Error_Code_Start", # Start Time of previous error code
                "[default]BACC_PFS2/OEE/HMI_Wiped", # Boolean if the HMI was wiped or not
                "[default]BACC_PFS2/OEE/Shift_Change", # Boolean if the HMI was wiped between 6-7.30 (Shift Change)
                "[default]BACC_PFS2/OEE/Changeover", # Boolean if the HMI was wiped outside shift change hours
                "[default]BACC_PFS2/OEE/Scheduled_Downtime/Scheduled_Stop_Ongoing"
            ])
            
            Old_Count_Value = tags[0].value
            LastStartTime = tags[1].value
            HMI_Wiped = tags[2].value
            Shift_Change = tags[3].value
            Changeover = tags[4].value
            Scheduled_Stop = tags[5].value
            #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 2")        
            # ----- IDENTIFYING ERROR DESCRIPTION -----
            Error_Dataset_Values = system.tag.readBlocking(["[default]BACC_PFS2/Faults/Error_Code_Database"])[0].value
            
            #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP: 2.1")
            
            Row_Count = Error_Dataset_Values.getRowCount()
            Error_Description = "Unknown Error: " + str(errorCode)
            
            for i in range(Row_Count):
                cell = Error_Dataset_Values.getValueAt(i, "Code")
                cell_int = int(cell)
                    
                if(cell_int == errorCode):
                    Error_Description = Error_Dataset_Values.getValueAt(i, "Description")
                    i = Row_Count
                    check_if_match = 1
            Error_Description_2  = Error_Description[:255]
            result = system.db.runPrepQuery("SELECT * FROM errorlog WHERE ErrorCode = ?", [errorCode], db) # Number of times current error code appears in the error log

            result_old = system.db.runPrepQuery("SELECT * FROM errorlog WHERE ErrorCode = ?", [prevErrorCode], db) # Number of times previous error code appears in the error log


            #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 3")

            # ----- CALCULATING LENGTH OF CURRENT ERROR -----
            
            current_time = system.date.now() # Getting current time
            TimeElapsed_Seconds = (current_time.getTime() - LastStartTime.getTime()) / 1000 # Calculating time elapsed
            
            
            #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 4")       
            # ----- FORMATTING TIME INTO HH:MM:SS -----
            formatted_time = "0s"
            hours = TimeElapsed_Seconds // 3600
            minutes = (TimeElapsed_Seconds % 3600) // 60
            seconds = TimeElapsed_Seconds % 60
            if (hours > 0):
                formatted_time = "{:02}h {:02}m {:02}s".format(hours, minutes, seconds)
            elif (minutes > 0):
                formatted_time = "{:02}m {:02}s".format(minutes, seconds)
            elif (seconds > 0):
                formatted_time = "{:02}s".format(seconds)	
                
            #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 5")           
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
            # ----- UPDATE TABLES WITH ELAPSED TIME -----
            
            if errorCode != prevErrorCode and prevErrorCode != 1:
                
                #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 6")
            
                system.db.runPrepUpdate("""
                    UPDATE `full_error_log`
                    SET `TimeElapsed` = TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, Time, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
                        `Time_Formatted` = ?,
                        `State` = 0
                    WHERE `Count_ID` = ?
                """, [formatted_time, Old_Count_Value], db)
                
                #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 7")
            
                
                if HMI_Wiped == 0:
                    if len(result_old) == 0:
                        
                        system.db.runPrepUpdate("""
                            UPDATE errorlog
                            SET `TotalDurationSeconds` = TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, LastStartTime, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
                                `IsActive` = 0,
                                `TimeFormatted` = ?
                            WHERE `ErrorCode` = ?
                        """, [formatted_time, prevErrorCode], db)

                        #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 8")
                    
                    else:
                        #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 9")
            
                        Elapsed_Time_Before = system.db.runPrepQuery(
                            "SELECT `TotalDurationSeconds` FROM `errorlog` WHERE `ErrorCode` = ?",
                            [prevErrorCode], db
                        )[0][0]
                        
                        Elapsed_Time_After = TimeElapsed_Seconds + Elapsed_Time_Before
                        
                        #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 10")
                        hours = Elapsed_Time_After // 3600
                        minutes = (Elapsed_Time_After % 3600) // 60
                        seconds = Elapsed_Time_After % 60
                        
                        if (hours > 0):
                            formatted_time_After = "{:02}h {:02}m {:02}s".format(hours, minutes, seconds)
                        elif (minutes > 0):
                            formatted_time_After = "{:02}m {:02}s".format(minutes, seconds)
                        elif (seconds > 0):
                            formatted_time_After = "{:02}s".format(seconds)
                        #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 11")

            
                        
                        system.db.runPrepUpdate("""
                            UPDATE `errorlog`
                            SET `IsActive` = 0,
                                `TimeFormatted` = ?,
                                `TotalDurationSeconds` = ?
                            WHERE `ErrorCode` = ?
                        """, [formatted_time_After, Elapsed_Time_After, prevErrorCode], db)
                        #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 12")
            
                else:
                    #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 13")
                    
                    system.db.runPrepUpdate("""
                        UPDATE `errorlog`
                        SET `OccurrenceCount` = OccurrenceCount - 1,
                            `IsActive` = 0
                        WHERE `ErrorCode` = ?
                    """, [prevErrorCode], db)
                    
                    if Shift_Change == 1:
                        reason = "Shift_Change"
                        code = 2
                    else:
                        reason = "Changeover"
                        code = 3
                        
                    result_SC = system.db.runPrepQuery("SELECT * FROM `errorlog` WHERE `ErrorDescription` = ?", [reason], db)
                    #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 14")
            
                    if len(result_SC) == 0:
                        
                        
                        
                        system.db.runPrepUpdate("""
                            INSERT INTO `errorlog` (`ErrorCode`, `ErrorDescription`, `OccurrenceCount`, `TotalDurationSeconds`, `LastStartTime`, `IsActive`, `Scheduled_Stop`, `TimeFormatted`)
                            VALUES (?, ?, 1, ?, ?, 0, 0, ?)
                        """, [code, reason, TimeElapsed_Seconds, LastStartTime, formatted_time], db)
                        

                    else:
                        
                        Elapsed_Time_Before_SC = system.db.runPrepQuery(
                            "SELECT `TotalDurationSeconds` FROM `errorlog` WHERE `ErrorDescription` = ?",
                            [reason], db
                        )[0][0]
                        
                        Elapsed_Time_After_SC = TimeElapsed_Seconds + Elapsed_Time_Before_SC
                        

            
                        hours_SC = Elapsed_Time_After_SC // 3600
                        minutes_SC = (Elapsed_Time_After_SC % 3600) // 60
                        seconds_SC = Elapsed_Time_After_SC % 60
                        
                        if (hours_SC > 0):
                            formatted_time_After_SC = "{:02}h {:02}m {:02}s".format(hours_SC, minutes_SC, seconds_SC)
                        elif (minutes_SC > 0):
                            formatted_time_After_SC = "{:02}m {:02}s".format(minutes_SC, seconds_SC)
                        elif (seconds_SC > 0):
                            formatted_time_After_SC = "{:02}s".format(seconds_SC)
                        
            
                        #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 15")
                        system.db.runPrepUpdate("""
                            UPDATE `errorlog`
                            SET `IsActive` = 0,
                                `TimeFormatted` = ?,
                                `TotalDurationSeconds` = ?,
                                `OccurrenceCount` = OccurrenceCount +1
                            WHERE `ErrorCode` = ?
                        """, [formatted_time_After_SC, Elapsed_Time_After_SC, code], db)
                    
                    
        
            #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 16")    
            # If the new error code is not 0, Update stop count, and add to tables
            if errorCode != 1 and errorCode != prevErrorCode :
                #Updating Error Count Values
                system.tag.writeBlocking(["[default]BACC_PFS2/Faults/Day_Stop_Count"], [Old_Count_Value + 1])# Adds Error into error code count memory tag
                New_Count_Value = system.tag.readBlocking(["[default]BACC_PFS2/Faults/Day_Stop_Count"])[0].value#Sets New count variable.
                

            
                #Updating/Inserting into Error log table
                if len(result) == 0:
                    # New error
                    
                    system.db.runPrepUpdate("""
                        INSERT INTO `errorlog` (`ErrorCode`, `ErrorDescription`, `OccurrenceCount`, `TotalDurationSeconds`, `LastStartTime`, `IsActive`, `Scheduled_Stop`)
                        VALUES (?, ?, 1, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 1, 0)
                    """, [errorCode, Error_Description_2], db)
                    
                
                    #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 17")
            
                else:

            
                    # Existing error, update count and start time
                    system.db.runPrepUpdate("""
                        UPDATE `errorlog`
                        SET `OccurrenceCount` = OccurrenceCount + 1,
                            `LastStartTime` = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                            `IsActive` = 1
                        WHERE `ErrorCode` = ?
                    """, [errorCode], db)
                    
                    
                # Inserting Error into Full Error Log Table
                system.db.runPrepUpdate("""
                    INSERT INTO `full_error_log` (`Code`, `Description`, `TimeElapsed`, `Time`, `State`, `Count_ID`, `Scheduled_Stop`)
                    VALUES (?, ?, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 1, ?, 0)
                """, [errorCode, Error_Description_2, New_Count_Value], db)
                #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("End of loop")
                

                #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 18")
                
            if (errorCode == 1 and HMI_Wiped == 1):
                system.tag.writeBlocking(["[default]BACC_PFS2/OEE/HMI_Wiped"], [0])
                system.tag.writeBlocking(["[default]BACC_PFS2/OEE/Shift_Change"], [0])           
            

            #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 19") 
            
            
            if(errorCode != prevErrorCode):
            	#system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 19.1")
                if(errorCode == 1 or prevErrorCode == 1):
                    #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 19.2")
                    system.tag.writeBlocking(["[default]BACC_PFS2/Faults/State_Change"], [system.date.now()])
                    #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 19.3")
            #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 20")
            
            #Calculations
            #Update last time state changed
            if (prevErrorCode != errorCode):
                system.tag.writeBlocking(["[default]BACC_PFS2/Faults/Error_Code_Start"], [system.date.now()])
                #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("RVP 21")
            
            
            #system.util.getLogger("Value Change Script").info("Script over")
    except Exception as e: #If any error occurs then give the reason to the Gateway logging.
        system.util.getLogger("PFS2 Value Change Script").error("Error is: " + str(e))

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,
        GREATEST(Start_Date, 
            CASE 
                WHEN NOW() < CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 07:00:00') 
                THEN DATE_SUB(CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 07:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) 
                ELSE CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 07:00:00') 
            END
        ),
        LEAST(End_Date, 
            CASE 
                WHEN NOW() < CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 07:00:00') 
                THEN CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 07:00:00') 
                ELSE DATE_ADD(CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 07:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) 
            END
        )
    )
), 0) AS total_overlap_seconds
FROM scheduled_stops
WHERE End_Date > 
    CASE 
        WHEN NOW() < CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 07:00:00') 
        THEN DATE_SUB(CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 07:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) 
        ELSE CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 07:00:00') 
    END
AND Start_Date < 
    CASE 
        WHEN NOW() < CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 07:00:00') 
        THEN CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 07:00:00') 
        ELSE DATE_ADD(CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 07:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) 
    END;
